New-session MergeInner conditionally calls cloud conversion and LLM merge variants. MergeCloudLLM constructs LLM candidates at 0x13a19c and calls PromoteByDecisionTree at 0x13b6b4. The promotion window calls MakeMergeTreeFeature, whose window calls FindMergeLLMFeature and CandidateInner::GetFeatureInfo.
